dataset: distinct source basenames; one stored target; source type index
scope: LinkedFiles/index lookups only; excludes collection capture, real type classification, cached-query index construction, CEL and network
sdk_bench_boundary: sdk-review/bench does not implement authority query semantics; this engine-only scenario lives in the assigned Rust worktree
notes: Non-gating microbenchmark on a shared machine; no speedup claim.
Policy re-resolution pays the shared bounded selector/evidence cost, unlike the default stored-winner shortcut.
Nearly flat per-link cost from 500 to 50k records; full query snapshot/index costs are not measured.

Before run used a git archive of the baseline inside this worktree's ignored target directory and an equivalent default-only private test. Package artifacts were cleaned before measuring current code to avoid shared-target binary collisions.
